SELECT strftime('%Y', l.date) AS loan_year, MIN(l.date) AS first_date, MAX(l.date) AS last_date, SUM(l.amount) AS total_amount
FROM main.loan AS l
WHERE l.account_id IN (
    SELECT d.account_id
    FROM main.disp AS d
    JOIN main.client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
    WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.gender = 'M'
)
GROUP BY strftime('%Y', l.date)
ORDER BY loan_year;

WITH loan_totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.date < '1997-01-01' THEN l.amount END) AS total_1996,
        SUM(CASE WHEN l.date >= '1997-01-01' THEN l.amount END) AS total_1997
    FROM main.loan AS l
    WHERE l.date >= '1996-01-01'
      AND l.date < '1998-01-01'
      AND l.account_id IN (
          SELECT d.account_id
          FROM main.disp AS d
          JOIN main.client AS c ON c.client_id = d.client_id
          WHERE d.type = 'OWNER' AND c.gender = 'M'
      )
)
SELECT 100.0 * (total_1997 - total_1996) / NULLIF(total_1996, 0) AS percentage_growth
FROM loan_totals
LIMIT 1
